sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
Experience
Aug 2024 LTIMindtree | Bangalore Senior Business Analyst
Working as a Business Analyst for Portland General Electric (PGE), partnering with
business and technology stakeholders to deliver enterprise data and analytics
solutions supporting strategic business initiatives.
Gather and analyze business requirements, conduct stakeholder workshops, and
translate business needs into BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and functional specifications. Collaborate with data engineering teams to design scalable data pipelines using
Snowflake, SQL, AWS Glue, and AWS S3 for enterprise reporting and analytics.
Perform data analysis, data mapping, source-to-target mapping, and impact analysis to
support system enhancements and business transformation initiatives.
Design executive dashboards and KPI reports using Power BI, enabling data-driven
decision-making across business units.
Support Agile ceremonies
including backlog grooming, sprint planning, UAT
coordination, and production deployments.
Ensure data quality through reconciliation, validation, and defect analysis while
coordinating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality business solutions.
04/2021 - 09/2023 Wells Fargo| Bangalore Senior Data Management Analyst
Collaborated with Capital Markets and Investment Banking stakeholders to gather,
analyze, and document business requirements for securities trading, capital markets, and regulatory reporting initiatives.
Prepared Business Requirement Documents
(BRDs), Functional Requirement
Documents (FRDs), process flows, use cases, and user stories supporting investment banking applications.
Conducted business analysis across the complete trade lifecycle, including trade
capture, trade validation, settlement, reconciliations, and post-trade reporting.
Performed impact analysis and gap analysis for enhancements affecting fixed income,
equities, derivatives, and securities processing platforms.
Worked with traders, investment banking stakeholders, risk, finance, and technology
teams to define functional requirements for strategic transformation initiatives.
Supported UAT planning,
test scenario preparation, defect management, and
production releases for capital markets applications.
Developed SQL queries to analyze financial datasets, validate trade data, reconcile
securities transactions, and support business reporting.
Built Power BI dashboards and MIS reports for trade monitoring, portfolio analytics,
exposure reporting, and regulatory compliance metrics.
Performed data lineage analysis, source-to-target mapping, and data validation to
ensure high-quality financial data across enterprise systems.
Participated in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement,
requirement prioritization, sprint reviews, and stakeholder demonstrations.
09/2019 - 03/2021
Lytcone Technologies| Bangalore Reporting Analyst
Worked closely with Finance stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and
develop monthly MIS reports and business dashboards.
Performed financial and operational data analysis to identify trends, variances, and
opportunities for business improvement.
Automated recurring reporting processes using Power Query and Advanced Excel,
significantly reducing manual reporting effort.
Conducted data validation and reconciliation to ensure the accuracy of payroll, GST,
receivables, and financial reports.
Delivered ad hoc business reports and analytical insights to support financial planning
and business decision-making.
Improved reporting processes by standardizing templates and enhancing reporting
quality.
03/2019 - 09/2019
Reliance Retail | Bangalore Department Manager Trainee
Supported business operations by analyzing sales performance, inventory levels, and
operational KPIs.
Prepared daily and monthly operational reports using Advanced Excel.
Assisted managers in monitoring inventory movement and identifying opportunities to
improve operational efficiency.
